title: Fix Facebook social link in footer

requirements.text: Update the Facebook social link so it navigates to a valid Facebook URL instead of the current placeholder, by changing the `FACEBOOK_URL` constant in `frontend/src/content/socialLinks.ts`.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the Facebook icon in the site footer navigates to a real Facebook page URL.

requirements.text: Harden the footer social icon links in `frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx` so placeholder URLs (e.g., '#', empty string) do not appear as 'broken links' to users: when a social URL is not a valid external URL, disable the icon interaction (no navigation) and apply a disabled visual state; when valid, open the link in a new tab with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` (apply consistently to Facebook and X/Twitter).
acceptanceCriteria: If `FACEBOOK_URL` is '#', clicking the Facebook icon does not change the page URL or scroll position and does not open a new tab.
If `FACEBOOK_URL` is a valid external URL, clicking the Facebook icon opens the URL in a new browser tab and includes `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
X/Twitter link behavior matches Facebook: opens in a new tab when configured to a valid external URL; otherwise it is non-interactive and visually disabled.

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or anything in `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose instead of modifying read-only UI component sources).
nonGoals: Implementing or changing any backend (Motoko) logic.
Adding new social networks beyond the existing LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and Facebook icons.
Adding third-party analytics or click tracking for social links.

preferencesToAdd: Use English for all user-facing text.
